summary.text: Walter Felag is a Democratic state senator who has represented Rhode Island State Senate District 10 since 1999 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works as a senior computer software engineer, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Felag earned a B.A. in math from Providence College in 1976.
He worked as a senior computer software engineer for Anteon Corporation.
Felag served on the Warren Town Council from 1978 to 1999 and was its president from 1986 to 1999.
